sequences.cfg:
con_logfile csdv_console.log
mirv_campath enabled 0
mirv_campath clear
mirv_campath load "{REPO}/videos/campaths/totemlake-gap-scene-clip1.xml"
mirv_campath offset none
mirv_campath enabled 1
mirv_cmd clear
mirv_cmd addAtTick 17144 mirv_campath offset current
mirv_cmd addAtTick 17280 mirv_campath enabled 0
r_drawviewmodel 0
cl_drawhud 0
mirv_cmd addAtTick 17280 cl_drawhud 1
mirv_cmd addAtTick 17122 spec_mode 3
host_framerate 240
mirv_streams settings add sampler csdvBlur1
mirv_streams settings edit csdvBlur1 settings csdmPreset1
mirv_streams settings edit csdvBlur1 fps 60
mirv_streams settings edit csdvBlur1 exposure 0.5
mirv_streams settings edit csdvBlur1 strength 1.0
mirv_streams settings edit afxDefault settings csdvBlur1
mirv_streams settings edit csdvBlur1
mirv_streams settings edit afxDefault
mirv_streams print
host_framerate
mirv_cmd addAtTick 17184 host_framerate
mirv_cmd addAtTick 17184 mirv_streams settings edit afxDefault
